common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
common.footer: Yoyo — rent anything from people nearby.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Yoyo
verifyEmail.preview: One click and your Yoyo account is ready.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Welcome to Yoyo! Confirm that this address is yours, so the people you rent with can reach you.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create a Yoyo account, just ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Yoyo password
resetPassword.preview: Set a new password for your Yoyo account.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset the password of your Yoyo account. If it was you, set a new one:
resetPassword.expiry: The link works for 1 hour and only once.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

phoneCode.subject: Your Yoyo phone confirmation code
phoneCode.preview: Enter this code on Yoyo to confirm your phone.
phoneCode.heading: Confirm your phone
phoneCode.body: Enter this code on Yoyo to confirm your phone number:
phoneCode.ignore: If you did not ask for a code, just ignore this email.

listingApproved.subject: Your listing is live on Yoyo
listingApproved.preview: People nearby can now find and rent it.
listingApproved.heading: Your listing is published
listingApproved.body: Good news: “{title}” passed moderation and is now in the Yoyo catalog. People nearby can find it and send you requests.

listingRejected.subject: Your Yoyo listing needs changes
listingRejected.preview: See what to fix and send it again.
listingRejected.heading: Your listing needs a few changes
listingRejected.body: Our moderators could not publish “{title}” yet. Here is why:
listingRejected.next: Fix it and send it for review again; it only takes a moment.
